name: med_requests
title: Medication Requests or Prescriptions
description: Medication Requests or Prescriptions related features. Medication Administrations are also included, since an administered medication is also prescribed.

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

feature.name: medicationGroups
feature.title: Medication groups
feature.description: Medication groups to be used when specific ATC codes are not available.

feature.name: startTime
feature.title: Medication start time
feature.description: MedicationRequest effective dose period start, or MedicationAdministration occurrence time

feature.name: endTime
feature.title: Medication end time
feature.description: MedicationRequest effective dose period end, or MedicationAdministration occurrence period end (equals the start time if the administration has no period end)
